component.name: BachelorPad+ Lite
component.summary: Text editor for notes and logs

description.p: Notepad when you want it, more when you need it. A plain text editor that opens instantly, never touches the network and cannot run anything, with one thing Notepad does not have: a note layer that knows which of your documents are about the same subject.
It opens the files Notepad opens -- UTF-8, UTF-16 and the legacy code pages -- and saves them back as they came. Unsaved work survives a crash and is offered back on the next launch.
